''simultaneous broadcast'' | runtime = | ratings = | producer = | director = | website = {{URL|www.sagawards.org}} | image2 = | image2size = | alt2 = | caption2 = | previous = [[20th Screen Actors Guild Awards|20th]] | main = [[Screen Actors Guild Awards]] | next = [[22nd Screen Actors Guild Awards|22nd]] }} The 21st ceremony of the [[Screen Actors Guild Awards]], awarded by [[SAG-AFTRA]] and honoring the best achievements in film and television performances for the year 2014, took place on January 25, 2015, at the [[Shrine Auditorium]] in [[Los Angeles]], California.{{cite news|title=SAG Award Winners 2015: Full List|url=https://variety.com/2015/film/news/sag-award-winners-2015-screen-actors-guild-awards-winner-list-1201414657/|access-date=January 27, 2018|work=Variety|date=January 25, 2015}}{{cite news|title=SAG Awards: Complete List of Winners|url=https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/news/sag-awards-2015-winners-list-765943|access-date=January 27, 2018|work=The Hollywood Reporter|date=January 25, 2015}} The ceremony was broadcast on both [[TNT (American TV network)|TNT]] and [[TBS (American TV channel)|TBS]] 8:00 p.m. [[Eastern Time Zone|EST]] / 5:00 p.m. [[Pacific Time Zone|PST]] and the nominees were announced on December 10, 2014.{{cite web|title=Nominations Announced for the 21st Annual Screen Actors Guild Awards|url=https://www.sagaftra.org/nominations-announced-21st-annual-screen-actors-guild-awards%C2%AE |publisher=[[SAG-AFTRA]] |access-date=December 26, 2016 |date=December 10, 2014}}{{cite web|last1=Johnson|first1=Zach|title=SAG Awards 2015: Complete List of Nominations!|url=https://www.eonline.com/news/604452/sag-awards-2015-complete-list-of-nominations|website=E! News|access-date=January 27, 2018|date=December 10, 2014}} [[Debbie Reynolds]] was announced as the 2014 SAG Life Achievement Award honoree on August 18, 2014.{{cite news|last1=Nordyke|first1=Kimberly|title=SAG Awards: Debbie Reynolds to Receive Life Achievement Honor|url=https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/news/sag-awards-debbie-reynolds-receive-726023|access-date=January 27, 2018|work=The Hollywood Reporter|date=August 18, 2014}} ==Winners and nominees== Winners are listed first and highlighted in '''boldface'''.
